content and style First, open the AI Studio Then, find the Graphic section Then, in the AI Graphic Generator upload a real picture Then, select the type and style you want to import Then, click Preview You will successfully see the effect of the import In the new part of the storage function, you can now save the selected ZPRJ files without changing the entire document under the basis of the entire document Now, I have selected only the upper part of the paper Then, I will go to Files Save As You will find that there is a button for Common Selected After completion, you will successfully save only the upper part of the paper In summary, users do not need to manually delete unnecessary documents as before before saving Now, this update can simplify your workflow Another new update is now in CLO When you use print or add print you can use the same PBR mapping with the same material This setting can make the surface of all printed papers look more harmonious after rendering and can be more accurate to show the light, texture and shadow effects After I have added the printed paper you will see in the Property Editor the option Use Same PBR Map as Fabric In addition, in the Normal Map, Displacement Map or Opacity Map and other PBR mapping you will also see the option Use Same PBR Map as Fabric In this state after we have selected all the options we can go to the Texture Editor to present or create a different blending mode effect After opening the Texture Editor we can see different blending modes and below you will find the option Color Switch After opening it you can choose the number of colors you want to switch After selecting the number select the color block on the corresponding color and then change the color After that, click Apply and Close Now you can see the immediate update in the 3D window You will find that the printed paper and the fabric are using the same PBR mapping This new update is a good choice for those who are looking for extremely precise or extremely high accuracy This new update is a good choice for those who are looking for high accuracy printing The next update is about Colorway In the previous version when you added or opened the document you could not directly enter the color you want to choose Now this new update when you open the CPRJ file you can select the document you want to import in the Garment Object You can now see that you can select All or Custom to import the color you want to use in the CLO There is a little note here If your CLO document is using 2025.0 or the previous version to import the document when you import the document it will only select the name of the colorway and will not show any thumbnail If you import this colorway in the next version it will look like what I showed in the video with the thumbnail Now I will remove the swimsuit and import it back in Let's look at another example After I added the colorway this time I will select Custom I will only choose two colors After importing you will find that the document will follow the colorway order of the opened document For example the first colorway will become black the second will become blue and the third one will automatically be the first colorway So you need to remember that when the second document is added to the previous document the colorway option is less than the first document You need to consider the order of addition In the new version we have optimized the keyframe animation This improvement is mainly divided into three stages First, the keyframe can be applied on different colorway Second, the keyframe animation can be applied on the V-Ray rendering Finally, we have added a new claim range to selected layers which means you can set the time range to the selected layer Now I will quickly show you the actual operation After opening the colorway editor you will see that there are three different color buttons on the top right corner The top right corner is the keyframe button How to select the keyframe button after adding the animation colorway You will see the new colorway bar in the animation editor If you want to switch to colorway 1 or colorway 2 at a specific time drag your time to the selected time and then press the keyframe button and so on Now when I play the animation you will see that the buttons and button holes are all the same This update can make the animation more natural during the process The second update about the keyframe can be found in rendering You can go to the light settings section and find the light settings you want to add or use After selecting you will find the light icon that was in the previous version is now activated to replace the option When you activate you will see the new keyframe For example, you can add the light intensity and angle In addition we have improved the setting of the finite dome Now when you open the finite dome you can change the height and the location of the keyframe The keyframe can be added individually Finally, about the keyframe update Now you can set the animation time range to the selected layer When you have completed the animation you want to add you can click on the bar on the right You will see the claim range to selected layers After selecting you will see the animation time automatically extended to the animation material you added This setting allows you to set the animation time The last update about the keyframe is about the export GLTF animation In the previous version when using GLTF to export an object it does not support the avatar animation So when your avatar uses any joints animation it will not be saved in the project So in the new version we have made some improvements to make the animation more dynamic First of all open a document and select export GLTF Through the window you can select avatar animation After selecting you will see two options Jones and Cache The joint mode allows you to save the bone structure and can be used to edit or play This is the most ideal option Cache is mainly for those who have not tied the bone avatar to make a more realistic animation Users can choose the most suitable layout for their needs The last part is the update We have introduced a new feature Graphic Configurator Users can directly change the graphic for the 3D garment When you enter the Graphic Configurator you can find Added Graphic Tools When you successfully activate this tool you will see Gizmo on the graphic You can move its outer circle or its tip or press the center point to change the size angle and position If you want to replace a new graphic you can use the same tool to upload a new graphic on the upper right corner The last update is about Content Analysis Through this new feature we can check your workflow and various activity analysis content In the upper right corner you can click Content Analysis Then you can go to this page In the upper right corner you will find Total Lead Time This shows the content created after the day The blue part shows the time of the day When your graphic is on a specific workflow it will show the number of activities in each state The bottom big timeline shows the detailed activity dates You can use this feature to explain lead time and time This is the end of the update of the new version of 2025.1 I hope this update can give you a more smooth and effective experience I hope you will continue to follow our development
markdown_content: # CLO 2025.1 New Features Overview (廣東話 Cantonese) This document details the new features and improvements introduced in CLO 2025.1, focusing on advanced pattern design, fabric simulation, AI integration, file handling, animation, and workflow enhancements. Key terms include Signals Blocking, Denim Washing Effects, 3D Pen, CLO Fab, Zipper Color Management, AI Studio, File Pre-settings, SoftBody Simulation, and Graphic Configurator. --- ## Signals Blocking: Advanced Seamless Pattern and Material Application This section explains the Signals Blocking feature, which enables users to draw wireless lines on patterns for applying different cloth materials, patterns, and colors within the same garment version, improving color matching and material customization. - **Functionality**: Users can draw wireless (seamless) lines on the outer edges of pattern boards in the 2D window using the Signals Blocking tool. The tool supports symmetrical and semi-symmetrical boards, with symmetrical lines mirrored automatically. - **Drawing Controls**: - Hold **Shift** for specific angles (45°, 90°). - Hold **Ctrl** to draw curved lines. - Edit points with curve tools or delete points to form straight lines. - **Offset Seamless Lines**: Users can create multiple offset seamless lines based on the original line, specifying the number and spacing (e.g., 3 lines at 2 cm intervals). - **Material Application**: Different fabrics can be dragged directly onto seamless blocks in the 2D window. Materials update simultaneously in the 3D window. - **Texture Editing**: Use **Edit Texture** to modify pattern direction, size, and scaling for customized effects. - **Symmetry Handling**: Materials apply independently on symmetrical versions, allowing different fabrics on either side. - **Pattern Modification**: Adjusting outer lines automatically updates seamless lines, enabling easy pattern changes without losing seamless block integrity. - **Trace Tool**: Converts inner or base lines into seamless blocking lines, enabling immediate material application and the addition of topstitch graphics on seamless blocks. - **Backward Compatibility**: Seamless block lines in older documents convert to basic lines, ensuring no disruption of legacy files. --- ## Denim Washing Effects: Realistic Fabric Simulation This section covers the new denim washing presets in CLO 2025.1, designed to simulate authentic denim fabric wear and wash effects with customizable parameters. - **Presets Included** (7 modes): 1. **Unwashed** — Original denim. 2. **Ticket Washing** — Even, soft color retention. 3. **Natural Polishing** — Slight fading and softening resembling long wear. 4. **Stone Washing** — Polished with cast iron for clear contrast. 5. **Suan Washing** — Strong marble texture effects. 6. **White Water Washing** — Bleaches denim toward white tones. 7. **Smell Wash** — Uniform color loss with subtle tone changes. - **Application and Adjustment**: Apply presets via the Fabric Popularity tab. Adjust strength (color loss), mixing mode (e.g., plastic plate color), absorption rate (dilution of edges), washing cycle (time), and sewing line effects. - **Sewing Line Effect**: Requires **Embroidery Puckering** on seams to enhance stitching visibility with darker outlines. - **Custom Washing Patterns**: Users can upload custom washing textures to replace presets. - **Bleach Mode**: Controls bleach density and mixing options for natural or pronounced bleaching effects. - **Recommendations**: Using plating functions and mixing modes improve realism by simulating actual denim wear processes. --- ## 3D Pen: Enhanced 3D Pattern Drawing Tool This section introduces upgrades to the 3D Pen Alphatar tool, enabling freehand drawing of pattern lines in 3D space for complex design outlines. - **Drawing Modes**: - Start drawing in Void (empty space) or toggle to 3D space using **P** key. - Supports curved lines (**Ctrl**) and fixed angles (**Shift**) with visual angle guides. - **Visual Aids**: - Press **D** to toggle display of distance from sketchbook to Alphatar. - **Completing Drawings**: Use the Flatten tool and press **Enter** to finalize and create the pattern from the 3D lines. - **Axes Guides**: Red (X-axis) and green (Y-axis) help with accurate, freeform 3D line placement. - **Benefits**: Enables visualization and creation of complex 3D outlines directly in CLO for designs imagined in spatial contexts. --- ## CLO Fab and CLO C-Fab Kit: Digitalized Pattern Creation and AI Integration This section describes CLO Fab, a new tool for creating high-quality, digitized fabric patterns with immediate 3D application, and the CLO C-Fab Kit for corporate AI-powered pattern development. - **Accessing CLO Fab**: Three activation methods: 1. From Object Browser → CLO Fab (creates new fabric). 2. Use CLO Fab button on existing fabric. 3. Via menu bar → CLO Fab. - **Features**: - Create seamless patterns manually or via CLO Fab Kit AI connection. - Import scanned fabric patterns directly. - Supports pattern cropping, updating, and previewing seamless tiling with options: normal, irregular, repeated pattern types. - **Physical Properties Editor**: - Input fabric type, ingredients (e.g., cotton, spandex), proportions, weight, and thickness. - Preview fabric draping and behavior on different model types (round, square, shoulder). - Advanced details adjust fabric effects in real-time. - **Saving and Exporting**: - Save fabrics with textures and mapping (normal map, roughness map, etc.). - Create and manage multiple pattern maps per fabric. - **C-Fab Kit**: - AI technology for precise, rapid digital pattern creation. - Corporate customers can integrate CLO’s AI solutions for enhanced workflows. --- ## Zipper Color Management and Style Storage This section covers the management and customization of zipper colors and styles in CLO 2025.1. - **Object Browser Access**: Zipper icon reveals zipper color list. - **Adding and Applying Zippers**: - Add new zipper colors/styles to the list. - Select zipper in 3D window and apply chosen style/color instantly. - **Style Copying and Editing**: - Copy existing zipper styles for reuse. - Edit zipper properties (size, material, color) via Property Editor. - **Storage of Zipper Styles**: - Save zipper styles as `.ZPS` files to reuse across projects. - Load stored zipper styles into other garments or documents. - **Management Tools**: - Right-click options: delete, reset, or re-identify zippers. - Delete all unused zippers to optimize project content. - **Workflow Benefits**: - Reduces repetitive work, maintains color consistency, and builds reusable zipper libraries. --- ## AI Studio: Integrated AI Functions Management This section details the new AI Studio interface and its improvements consolidating all AI features. - **Centralized AI Hub**: All AI functions (Textures, Graphics, Render) integrated into one window for easier access and management. - **Activation Process**: - Activate AI features via Account Management → Software Configuration. - After activation, AI functions become enabled and visible (no longer grayed out). - **User Interface**: - New AI icon in the upper right corner opens AI Studio. - Provides access to all AI tools and new features in one place. - **Legacy AI Functions**: - Previous AI functions are disabled in versions before 2025.1; activation only possible in 2025.1 or later. --- ## File Import/Export Pre-settings for Efficiency This section explains the new functionality allowing users to save and reuse import/export pre-settings for file operations. - **Supported Formats**: FBX and other 3D file types for import/export. - **Workflow**: - When importing or exporting, users can select and save specific pre-settings, including naming them. - Saved pre-settings appear as selectable options for subsequent file operations, eliminating repetitive manual adjustments. - **Demonstration**: - Import FBX file → configure settings → save pre-setting. - Re-import same or different file → select saved pre-setting to apply instantly. - **Benefit**: Saves time and ensures consistent file handling parameters across sessions. --- ## Unit System and Decimal Precision Control This section introduces user control over unit display precision in the system settings. - **Location**: User Settings → User Interface → Unit System → Decimal Places. - **Functionality**: - Set decimal places for clothing size measurements (e.g., 4 decimal places). - Ensures units and actual sizes remain consistent and precise. --- ## AI Pattern Drafter Enhancements This section describes enhancements to the AI Pattern Drafter allowing image-based pattern creation. - **New Feature**: Users can now upload real-life clothing images
